hook.title: I 3D printed a *Ghost* that actually talks back
hook.cover: I printed a Ghost that talks

end.title: STLs + code are *free*
end.sub: link in bio · part 2 is the wiring

caption:
I wanted a Ghost on my desk that actually talks. So I printed one.

12 parts, about 500 g of filament, about 32 hours on the printer. Raspberry Pi 4 inside, a round 1.28" screen for the eye, a 16-LED ring and three servos. Say "Hey Ghost" and it answers in character.

The shell is built straight off the Bungie reference sheet and it spreads open like the in-game scan.

STLs and code are free, link in bio.

Fan project. Destiny and the Ghost belong to Bungie.
